claims.statement: Monitoring uses the canonical missions model; the experimental monitoringJobs model is not registered.
Workbench endpoints are read-only semantic projections of canonical runtime records and do not create a parallel scheduler or data model.
The application opens on one compact role-aware Home with one contextual primary action, explicit decision rationale and progressive actor authority guidance.

The bootstrap response projects a canonical server-issued access profile describing identity, capabilities, prohibited actions, state effects and evidence; the UI does not infer authority from button visibility alone.
A read-only role-aware support surface explains ICTC architecture, journeys, terminology, benchmark mappings, runtime proof and explicit limitations without adding another operational domain model.
The final cascade resolves legacy visual aliases onto the canonical color token vocabulary and provides explicit focus, target, reflow, reduced-motion and forced-colors baselines.
Administration gains one compact read-only proof panel separating repository and runtime evidence from deployment gaps without introducing a new write workflow.

The rendered experience uses server-issued capabilities for write affordances, explains actor authority, provides compact mobile, keyboard and touch-safe presentation rules, and keeps onboarding read-only.
Auditor access remains read-only, does not impersonate an administrator, displays explicit authority and standard-proof context, and exposes evidence through the active auditor identity.

The repository contains an executable 18-dimension enterprise assurance model with per-dimension N+15 saturation, universal invariant convergence, source probes, selected runtime stress and explicit falsification; it does not certify deployment controls.
The ICTC 1.4 experience model remains a regression contract that enumerates 23,328 declared scenarios, freezes at N=23,392 and demonstrates zero novelty in the following 100 model probes.
The 1.6 model enumerates 787,320 declared experience scenarios with M+100 zero novelty and compresses 153 semantic inputs into 124 canonical primitives with N+100 zero novelty.
Deployment certification requires external identity, TLS, storage, backup, malware scanning, observability and accessibility evidence.
